Commentary.Commentary: Ireland are through to the next round. Next up - A do-or-die match between Scotland and Zimbabwe. The winner goes through. Switch the tabs and join us for that match. Till then, cheers!

Andy Balbirnie says this win means everything to them. Adds last year was disappointing but the coach changed, many things changed and it worked for them. Shares that they are in a good position and are ready to make more upset further now. Tells Paul Stirling is one of the best better, even Lorcan Tucker played well. Ends by saying it is a proud day for them.

Nicholas Pooran says it's tough and accepts they have not batted well in the tournament. Congratulates the Ireland performance. Adds there are many positives and it is a learning experience for them. They are disappointed with how things went and this defeat hurts them.

Gareth Delany is the Player of the Match. He says it is an incredible day. Last year they had a tough time but they are happy this time that they have done in some fashion. Adds the spin bowling coach came up with the plan and it worked for them. Shares the players put their hands up and have contributed well.
...Presentations next...

The spinners were getting more purchases on the pitch and West Indies came up with just one, Akeal Hosein. The pacers were taken to the cleaners. Right from the start, West Indies were on the back foot and there was never a moment where the Windies thought they had a chance. A poor performance from them overall.

West Indies opted to bat first and it turned out to be a very bad decision. Apart from Brandon King, no one turned up with the bat. They finished with a below par score and Ireland made a mockery of it. Paul Stirling, who was having one of the worst years with the bat, turned his form around and played one of his most important innings. Lorcan Tucker supported him and played brilliant innings as well. A comprehensive win and a proud day for the Irish people to remember.

Ireland have knocked the two-time World Champions out in some fashion. What a victory for Ireland. A day to remember for them! Ireland qualify for the next round. A one-sided affair and its time for the Windies to pack their bags and go home. Too early for the two-time champions but they were beaten comprehensively.

FOUR! Lorcan Tucker hits the winning runs! Superb scenes at the Hobart as Tucker hits it away, The Ireland players are jumping. The crowd are in full swing. Wow. Full and outside off, this is hit over covers for a boundary. IRELAND WIN BY 9 WICKETS.
Scores level! Very full, outside off. Paul Stirling drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A length ball on middle. Paul Stirling defends off the splice to point.
The celebrations have begun in the crowd! Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one. 2 runs needed now.
This is full and outside off. Paul Stirling swings and misses.
Full and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Tucker taps it to third man for one more.
A single as this is worked to third man.
This is very full and outside off. Tucker drives it to deep cover for a single.
A yorker, outside off. Paul Stirling looks to dab it away but misses. Ireland are one hit away.
Full and slanting onn the pads. Tucker flicks but miscues his shot completely. It goes off the top edge and falls safely towards square leg. A single.
Full and outside off, driven to cover.
On middle, Paul Stirling steps across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
THROUGH THE HANDS! This is full and on middle. Paul Stirling makes room to go over covers but mistimes and the ball goes through the hands of the leaping fielder for a brace.
FOUR! Just cheeky! Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling steps across and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off, length. Tucker punches it straight to cover. 14 runs needed now.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! On a length and on middle. Tucker makes room and steps down, gets in line of the ball and launches it over long on for a biggie.
TAP AND RUN! Length and on off. Paul Stirling works it to point for a quick single.
Short ball, slower and on middle. Tucker pulls it past mid-wicket for one.
On a length and on middle. Tucker nudges off the back foot to mid-wicket.
On middle, blocked out.
Outside off, cut to point for one.
Edgy runs! Floated full and outside off. Tucker steps across to work on the leg side but gets an inside edge and it rolls past the stumps to fine leg for a brace.
SIX! Clean hit! Tossed up, outside off. Tucker shuffles across and slog-sweeps it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tossed up, outside off. Tucker reverse sweeps but mistimes it to backward point.
This one skids on, flat and outside off. Tucker looks to push at it but misses.
Flatter and outside off. Paul Stirling punches it to deep cover for one.
A full toss, outside off, driven to covers. Ireland need 32 runs in 42 balls now.
Full and on middle. Tucker flicks straight to mid-wicket.
Tad short and on middle. Lorcan Tucker pulls to the left of deep mid-wicket for another couple of runs.
This is full and on middle, Tucker makes room and drives it through covers for easy couple.
On middle, this is hit to square leg for one.
Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling punches it to cover.
On off, kept out.
Length and outside off. Paul Stirling pushes it through covers for a single.
Very full and on middle. Lorcan Tucker mistimes his sweep over square leg for one.

NO BALL! Not out it is! Muted celebration from the Windies as they know it is a little bit late. Short and on middle. Lorcan Tucker looks to pull but gets a top edge and the ball lobs back to Odean Smith who takes it with ease. The umpire wants to check the front foot and guess what, it is that type of day for the Windies. Odean Smith has overstepped. Free-hit coming up...
Length and outside off. Paul Stirling plays it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Fifty for Stirling. His 21st but the most-important one. Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling opens the face of the bat and plays it fine to third man for four.
Outside off, guided through point for a single.
On off, blocked out.
THREE RUNS! 100 up! This is full, slow and on off. Lorcan Tucker chips it over mid on. The ball races to the ropes but Jason Holder runs back and stops with his boot. Saves a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Paul Stirling drives it to long off for a run.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Paul Stirling is playing a match-winning knock! On a length and outside off. Paul Stirling steps across and whacks it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Back of a length and on middle. Paul blocks it out.
Length and on middle. Tucker flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Drinks! Ireland are cruising toward victory. 57 runs needed in 60 balls with 9 wickets in hand. West Indies need a couple of wickets to build some pressure or else this will be a one-sided affair.
A single as this is worked through square leg.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
On off, this is played to cover for one more.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tossed up outside off, this is lofted over cover for one.
Outside off, this is cut past point for a run.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one more.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Two more! On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for two.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, this is played to point.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! On middle, this is hit through square leg for a boundary.
On middle, defended.
OUT! TAKEN! Windies finally get a wicket but is it too late! Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to backward point. Mayers takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is hit towards cover.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Andy Balbirnie works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
A fuller ball on off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Nice and fine! On the pads, Andy Balbirnie works it fine on the leg side and this one races away to the fence for a boundary.
Shorter and outside off, Paul Stirling cuts it through point and takes one.
Sensible batting will do it! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A misfield and a run to end a brilliant Powerplay for Ireland. They are well and truly on top of the game! Length and on off, this is pushed towards point. The fielder misfields and a run is taken.
Angled into the pads, Paul Stirling works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Over point for another boundary! Length and on off, Paul Stirling hits it on the up and this goes past point and into the fence behind. What a Powerplay this has been.

FOUR! Nothing going West Indies' way! Shorter and outside off, Paul Stirling slashes at it, it flies off the outside edge wide of the third man fielder who tries to push it back in but fails to do so.
More dots needed to build the pressure! Fuller and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
A dot to end! On off, defended.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Two more! Outside off, Andy Balbirnie guides it past short third man and takes two.
Length and on off, defended.
SIX! Over the fence! Full and outside off, this is hit over the cover fielder for a biggie.
Outside off, this is carved over point for one.
Three dots in a row to end but the damage was done earlier on! On middle, defended.

Direct hit and Andy Balbirnie was in trouble! Windies need to take these chances! On middle, this is pushed towards the bowler. Smith can't stop it but Stirling was worried about the ball being deflected back onto the stumps at his end. He looks to get back. Andy is off for a run but is sent back. The fielder at mid on picks the ball up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Back of a length and on off, Andy Balbirnie defends.
FOUR! EDGY! Not sure if giving Smith was the good move over Holder! Outside off, Andy Balbirnie slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge wide of the short third man fielder and into the fence.
SIX! Over the fence! The openers are taking the game away. Just the 106 more needed! On the shorter side. Andy Balbirnie looks to pull, this goes off the top edge but well over the fine leg fence.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries now! This is a poor delivery! Down the leg side. Andy Balbirnie just helps it on its way over the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, Stirling works it through mid-wicket and takes two. The last two balls spoils the over completely.
SIX! Over the fence! On middle, it is the slower one. Paul Stirling picks it and heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Top shot.
Well fielded! Fuller and on off, Paul Stirling hits it hard back towards the bowler who stops it well.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided. Extras are something Windies can't afford.

OUCH! That might have hurt, it might have really hurt! Paul Stirling is in a lot of pain! On middle, Paul Stirling shuffles across and looks to heave it on the leg side but misses to get hit near the box. He is in some pain and is rightly taking some time for himself.
On middle, Paul Stirling is cramped for room! Defended.
On middle, Andy Balbirnie works it towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR MORE! Wonderful batting! On the pads, Stirling plays it behind square, the sweep shot is out again. It goes fore another boundary. Ireland racing along now. 16 from the second over.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on for a quick run. Good sensible batting.
SIX! That is a top shot! It made a cracking sound of the bat. This is bowled outside off, flatter. Andy Balbirnie plays the sweep and it sails over the square leg fence. Ireland are off to a flier.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Not timed well again! Stirling makes room, this is fired on middle, Stirling lofts it over mid off and takes two.
Just over! Obed McCoy was in two minds whether to turn and run or back paddle. Stirling looks to sweep, this is on middle, it goes off the top edge just over short fine leg for two.
Akeal Hosein will bowl from the other end.
A dot to end! Five from the first! A good over by Obed McCoy! On the pads, Andy Balbirnie looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad.
Back of a length and on off, Andy defends.
Outside off, Stirling goes after it, it goes off the toe-end down to third man for one.

EDGY FOUR! Ireland won't mind how they come as long as they do! Shorter and outside off, Stirling slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge over the slip fielder, the fielder at third man dives over the ball. Boundary. Ireland and Paul Stirling are off the mark.
Swing and a miss! Obed McCoy bowling with good pace! Shorter and outside off, Stirling steps out and swings but misses.
A good delivery to begin with! Length and on off, angling it away. Stirling looks to push it on the up but misses.
